passwords.notice_body:
Local password vault notice

• Saved site addresses, usernames and passwords are kept only in the encrypted vault on this device.

• Entries are never sent to a DaliNira server and are not synced between devices.

• The vault is protected by your master password. If you forget your master password, the entries cannot be recovered; there is no developer back door.

• No security system provides absolute protection. Malware or a compromised device remains a risk.

• You can turn the feature off at any time. Turning it off doesn't delete the vault; permanent deletion requires a separate confirmation.

• This experimental feature isn't yet recommended for banking, government, primary email or crypto accounts.
